name: JG_ZZ_VAT_REP_ENTITIES
description: This is a key table which stores VAT reporting entities configuration setup.  A combination of legal entity, tax regime and tax registration number uniquely identifies record in this table.  Configuration information also includes details regarding tax colander, threshold amount for reporting and flags to indicate reporting method used like Allocation Rules or VAT Registers

columns.name: VAT_REPORTING_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: VAT Reporting Entity configuration Identifier

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal Entity Identifier

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Identifier

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax Regime Code

columns.name: TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: First Party Tax Registration Number

columns.name: TAX_CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Accounting Calender used for Tax Reporting

columns.name: ENABLE_REGISTERS_FLAG
columns.description: Possible values Y or N.  Value Y indicates VAT Registers method  is enabled

columns.name: ENABLE_REPORT_SEQUENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Possible values Y or N.  Value Y indicates report sequence is enabled

columns.name: ENABLE_ALLOCATIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Possible values Y or N.  Value  Y indicates Allocation Rules method is enabled

columns.name: ENABLE_ANNUAL_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Possible values Y or N. Value Y indicates Annual Allocations are enabled

columns.name: THRESHOLD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Indicates minimum transaction amount for VAT Reporting

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTITY_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Reporting Entity level. Possible values are Legal Entity, Ledger, Balancing Segment Value

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Reporting entity type. Possible values are:Legal, Accounting.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger Identifier

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Balancing segment value

columns.name: MAPPING_VAT_REP_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Mapping VAT Reporting Entity Identifier

columns.name: ENTITY_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Reporting Entity Identifier

columns.name: DRIVING_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Driving date for the relevant calendar and tax registration number

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date the tax reporting entity goes into effect.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date the tax reporting entity expires.

columns.name: TAX_REGISTRATION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to tax registrations table

columns.name: TAX_POINT_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies driving date of the tax reporting entity is tax point date.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_DATE_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: The  date from which the tax point date approach is effective for the reporting entity.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_DATE_EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: The  date upto which the tax point date approach is effective for the reporting entity.

columns.name: DRIVING_DATE_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: The  date from which the reporting date approach is effective for the reporting entity.

columns.name: DRIVING_DATE_EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: The  date upto which the tax point date approach is effective for the reporting entity.

columns.name: ENABLE_FINAL_DATA_VALIDATION
columns.description: Indicates whether validation is enabled for new or modified transactions before finalization. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: ENABLE_SWEEP_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether new or modified transactions that are identified during finalization process will be swept to next open tax period. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: TAX_CALENDAR_START_PERIOD
columns.description: Start period of tax reporting for entity.
